title: canair raw-CAN log index
description: Machine schema for captures/can/index.yaml — per-file metadata for imported raw broadcast-CAN frame logs. The log files themselves (.blf/.asc/.csv/candump/gvret) are stored natively alongside in captures/can/; this file only indexes them (they are high-volume and are NOT exploded into the captures/*.yaml schema). Written/updated by `canair import can` (Stage 1).

log.description: One imported raw-CAN log file and its metadata.

source.description: Provenance — capture device/tool, or upstream URL for imported third-party logs.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, optionally with a -<suffix> for a second same-day log.

vehicle_states.description: Power states the car was in while logging (vocabulary from states.yaml).

id_set.description: Distinct arbitration IDs seen in the log (hex strings, e.g. 0x220, 0x18DAF110).
